quantifiers: los principales motores (the main drivers) -> drive ("main" dropped)
other: sugiere una cierta complacencia (suggests) -> reveal a certain indulgence (hedge turned into assertion)
especular sobre sus planes -> wild guessing about its intentions (pejorative "wild" added)
pairs.notes: Original is Spanish, rewrite is English; translation alone not counted. Pyongyang is in both. "alarmante" -> "concerning" treated as tone, not counted. The "principales" item is borderline.

other: prepararli (prepare them) -> getting ready (object lost, reflexive sense)
formaggio liquido (liquid cheese) -> creamy cheese
pairs.notes: Original is Italian, rewrite English. "cinque" = "five" (same). "sempre" = "always", "solo" = "just" unchanged. Original is near-nonsense; improvvisazione -> spontaneity and processo -> act left out as near-synonyms.

quantifiers: Every task assigned -> The assignments (universal quantifier dropped)
other: ready for its execution -> diligently undertaken (different claim)
sometimes felt like setbacks -> occasionally hindered progress (perception turned into actual hindrance)
each mistake taught valuable insights -> yielded significant improvements in how we approach tasks (learning turned into realized improvement)
pairs.notes: "at times"/"sometimes" -> "occasionally" treated as equivalent. "rigorous" -> "considerable challenge" left out as close.

Italian to English. Amazon in both. Alcuni -> Some and Altri -> Others are the same. Left out as too small: reazioni contrastanti -> varied responses, consumatori -> users, offerte promesse -> advertised deals, perdita di scelta -> reduced options.

other: my first job in the corporate world -> embarked on my career path (first job and corporate setting dropped)
overwhelmed with mixed feelings -> felt both excited and apprehensive (overwhelmed dropped)
eye-opening experience -> exhilarating journey (different characterization)
excitement for challenges and opportunities -> excited about potential growth and challenges (opportunities replaced by growth)
pairs.notes: I treated "first" in "first job" as a descriptive ordinal and put it in other, not numbers. If ordinals count as numbers, "first" is missing from the rewrite.

Cunningham, New York and "quattro decenni"/"quattro decadi" are the same; "quasi" kept. Spesso -> molte volte, senza pause -> senza interruzioni, ogni angolo -> ogni strada treated as equivalent. Left out as style: dedizione -> passione, archivio vivente -> archivio in movimento, moda di strada -> moda urbana, ufficio -> studio, per terra -> dal pavimento.

other: nessuno li ha guardati (no one looked at them) -> no one has stared at them (weaker claim)
ancora sullo schermo -> still flicker on the screen (flickering added)
pairs.notes: Italian to English. "I numeri di ieri" -> "Yesterday's figures" has no numeric values. "nessuno" -> "no one" and "non parlare" -> "stay silent" keep the same polarity. Hai fatto scorrere -> swept aside is a possible shift but I left it out as figurative.

quantifiers: (none) -> generally (hedge added to "supporters generally refrain from using the veto")
other: the bill falls out for the year resulting in re-filing that year -> shelved for the year and must be reintroduced later (when it can be refiled changed)
veto powers explicitly provided for -> veto rights established ("explicitly" dropped)
by another chamber -> by another body (chamber generalized)
pairs.notes: "4." and "one chamber" are in both; "at least one" -> "a minimum one" is the same. "unless all alternatives fail" -> "unless no viable alternatives remain" treated as equivalent. Headings changed wording but are not names. Section names (Second Reading, General Notice, Committee, House, UK/Canada, Resolution) are all in both.

only faint rattle -> steady beeping ("only" dropped)
